$Comment: Leyline, the Arcane Focus's signature: an Arcane hit (where the Arcane damage line counts) slows its foe to half speed for 2 seconds (the game's Slow, a Slow to a boss's rules, so a boss or an elite shrugs it). It has no wait of its own: any Arcane hit may slow, and the foe's Immunity stops a lock, since each slow that lands ramps it, so a foe slowed again soon is slowed shorter each time (full, three quarters, half, a quarter) and then shrugs slows for a while; an Immune foe is passed over. Opens on the Signature step while the Arcane Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
